_doc: Shared across every keyword spec in this directory: the size profiles and the voice roster for scripts/gen_wake_corpus.py. `--profile` picks a row; `--voices/--positives-limit/...` override individual fields.
_azure_note: Standard Azure Neural voices (not HD/Dragon — those bill 2x). Mixed accent + gender + one child voice. Order matters: --voices N takes the first N. Verify availability in your region's voice list; a missing name fails that clip with a clear error.
_piper_note: Multi-speaker piper voice model (the training env has en_US-libritts_r-medium, 904 speakers). Point --piper-model at the .onnx; --voices N speaker ids are sampled evenly across [0, speaker_max).
